case: A Tier-3 record whose resource kind, task attribution and description were inferred by a model — every such field carries the violet machine-inferred badge
invented: INVENTED. Every rendering fixture is hand-built — there is no upstream artifact with a fabricated 300-character title, and binding one to a live DOI would make a false claim about somebody's work. Identifiers use the reserved 10.5072 DataCite test prefix and the Zenodo sandbox host, and no author named here is a real person. See fixtures/rendering/README.md.
note: The DOI came from a regex sweep and was resolved against DataCite before the record existed — the model never supplies an identifier. `resource_kind` at 0.41 confidence is the low-confidence case (x-05); `iea_task` is a pinned extraction (x-09). The licence is free text the register does not recognise (zen-08 / dc-09): it maps to `notspecified` with `license_mapped: false`, and the page must say the licence was not recognised rather than imply openness.
